headword: {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}
gloss: rising in the world; achieving success in life

definitions.gloss: rising in the world; worldly success; social advancement
definitions.explanation: Achieving success and social status through one's own efforts. A four-character compound combining {立身|りっしん} (establishing oneself) and {出世|しゅっせ} (getting ahead in the world). Historically an important ideal in Japanese society.

examples.japanese: {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}る→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧。
examples.english: To dream of rising in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧だった。
examples.english: In the Meiji era, rising in the world was the goal of young people.

examples.japanese: {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people left their hometowns for Tokyo to make their way in the world.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining {立身|りっしん} (establishing oneself) and ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧ (getting ahead). This concept was central to Japanese values especially during the Meiji era (1868–1912), when education and personal effort were seen as paths to social mobility. The phrase often evokes a somewhat old-fashioned or literary tone today.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}る→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧: to dream of worldly success
- {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim for success in life
- {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧: a story of rising in the world; a success story
- {立身出世|りっしんしゅっせ}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: careerism; success-oriented thinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧: getting ahead; career advancement — the second half of the compound, used alone in modern speech
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧: success — more general and modern
- {栄達|えいたつ}: attaining high rank — formal, literary word for achieving honor and position
